relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN — LOUD, AND THE SECOND ONE ON THIS SAME KEY. The seeded id names a two-author monograph on basic hypergeometric series published by a university press. This PDF's front matter shows a three-author arXiv preprint from two decades later on the explicit evaluation of q-Stokes matrices for confluent hypergeometric q-difference equations. Different author count, different decade, different document type. Two distinct documents in this slice (this one and library/arxiv-1404.2541v1/1404.2541v1.pdf) are both joined to the same id, which is the signature of a machine guess keyed on the words 'basic hypergeometric' appearing in an abstract. I set `id: null`; no `ref()` entry exists for these authors or this arXiv id. GENUINELY RELEVANT AND UNREGISTERED. Corpus-grep per AGENTS.md §'Before declaring open' over docs/, content/, computations/ and docs/coordination/ finds no entry. The corpus's active W2 Stokes attack (`docs/audits/2026-08-08-w2-stokes-qborel-attack-plan.md`, `QOU/MathlibExt/QBorelKernel*.lean`, `QOU/QBeta/C1*.lean`, bean qou-qbp5) needs explicit q-Stokes matrices, and the registry itself records at references.ts:7652 that the registered RSZ frame covers only integral slopes and gives dimension 0 for a single-slope module. This document computes q-Stokes matrices explicitly, in block form, by q-Borel resummation, and shows they degenerate to the classical confluent-hypergeometric Stokes matrices as q → 1 — a classical-limit consistency check the corpus has no other source for.

keyResults.statement: Under an explicit condition on the matrix A, the q-Stokes matrix S_q(z, λ, μ; E_nn, A) of the confluent hypergeometric q-difference system takes an explicit block matrix form.
keyResults.useForFolio: A closed-form q-Stokes matrix to compare against the 4₁ / 5₂ descendant equation's Stokes data.

keyResults.locator: Thm 1.2 (proved in §3; connection matrix at Thm 3.8)
keyResults.statement: A connection formula for ₙφ_{n−1}(a₁,…,a_{n−1},0; b₁,…,b_{n−1}; q, z) via q-Borel resummation, with the connection matrix given explicitly.
keyResults.useForFolio: An explicit connection matrix for a basic hypergeometric series — the object C1ConnectionPoles.lean carries abstractly.

keyResults.statement: As q → 1 the q-Stokes matrices recover the known Stokes matrices of the corresponding confluent hypergeometric differential system.
keyResults.useForFolio: A classical-limit consistency check for any q-Stokes construction the corpus builds.
